title: Product Packshot Photos for Multiple Views | AIVideosUGC
description: Turn one photo per side into clean packshots of the front, back, top and base. AI multi-angle product photos for galleries and paid social ads.
h1: Product Packshot Photos for Every Side You Photographed
lead: Open a packshot scene, add one photo of each real side, and download square views of the front, back, top and base.

steps.d: Upload one photo for each side, with the whole item in frame. A real photo of that side keeps ports, handles and corners accurate.
Name the view and one clean backdrop, then reuse that wording for every side. Compare the downloads before grouping, because the background can still shift.
Download each view and compare controls with your source photos. Place the set after the hero image on the listing or in the ad.

faq.q: How do I make product packshot photos of every side?
faq.a: Upload one photo of each side, name one shared backdrop, and download the square set. Put the front first, then the sides that answer questions about ports, buttons or the base.

faq.q: Can one photo show a port that was hidden?
faq.a: No. Photograph that side and upload it. A generated view is not a reliable way to reveal a connector, latch or control that was never in frame.

faq.q: Which file types can I upload?
faq.a: Use a JPG, PNG or WebP that shows the whole product clearly. Keep the item fully in frame so corners and handles are not cut off.

faq.q: How many views does a listing need?
faq.a: Three or four cover many galleries: front, back, and one or two detail sides. Add a base or control view when shoppers usually ask about it.

faq.q: What does each angle photo cost?
faq.a: Each product photo costs 24 credits. The cost is shown before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Where should the set sit in a gallery?
faq.a: Keep a clear hero image first. Add the packshot set after it so shoppers see the full item before the side views.

faq.q: Do the source photos already have to be square?
faq.a: No. Upload a clear JPG, PNG or WebP with the whole side in frame. Each download is a square 1:1 image.

faq.q: Can I run these images as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloaded photos have no watermark and can be used in your listings and your own paid ads. Compare the controls with the source before you launch.

faq.q: Do I need a turntable or a studio?
faq.a: No. The square views come from the side photos you upload and the backdrop you name. You do not book a reshoot for the set.

faq.q: Will every view share the same background?
faq.a: Name one backdrop and reuse that wording on every side, then compare the downloads. The background can still shift, so do not post a set that does not match.

steps.prompt: Use the uploaded speaker as the exact product. Show coordinated front and rear views with plain unmarked raised-dot controls and the USB-C port visible, preserving its shape, color and wrist strap. Neutral studio background, no text or logos.
